     7	import HartshorneLib.Chapter4PrincipalDivisors
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Hartshorne II.6: linear equivalence and the divisor class group
    11	
    12	Two divisors are linearly equivalent when their difference is principal. This
    13	file records the equivalence relation, constructs the quotient by the subgroup
    14	of principal divisors, and identifies linear equivalence with equality in that
    15	quotient.
    16	-/
    17	
    18	set_option autoImplicit false
    19	
    20	universe u
    21	
    22	open CategoryTheory
    23	open AlgebraicGeometry
    24	
    25	namespace Hartshorne
    26	
    27	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    28	variable {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} [IsIntegral X.left]
    29	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] [IsProper X.hom]
    30	
    31	/-- Two curve divisors are linearly equivalent when their difference is a
    32	principal divisor. -/
    33	def LinearlyEquivalent (D E : CurveDivisor k X) : Prop :=
    34	  D - E ∈ principalDivisors
    35	
    36	/-- The divisor class group, obtained by quotienting divisors by principal
    37	divisors. -/
    38	noncomputable def DivisorClassGroup : Type u :=
    39	  CurveDivisor k X ⧸ principalDivisors
    40	
    41	noncomputable instance : AddCommGroup (DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (X := X)) :=
    42	  inferInstanceAs (AddCommGroup (CurveDivisor k X ⧸ principalDivisors))
    43	
    44	/-- The class of a divisor in the divisor class group. -/
    45	noncomputable def divisorClass :
    46	    CurveDivisor k X →+ DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (X := X) :=
    47	  QuotientAddGroup.mk' principalDivisors
    48	
    49	/-- Linear equivalence is exactly equality of divisor classes. -/
    50	theorem linearlyEquivalent_iff_divisorClass_eq (D E : CurveDivisor k X) :
    51	    LinearlyEquivalent D E ↔ divisorClass D = divisorClass E := by
    52	  simp only [LinearlyEquivalent, divisorClass]
    53	  exact QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem.symm
    54	
    55	/-- Linear equivalence is reflexive. -/
    56	theorem linearlyEquivalent_refl (D : CurveDivisor k X) :
    57	    LinearlyEquivalent D D :=
    58	  (linearlyEquivalent_iff_divisorClass_eq D D).mpr rfl
    59	
    60	/-- Linear equivalence is symmetric. -/
    61	theorem linearlyEquivalent_symm {D E : CurveDivisor k X}
    62	    (h : LinearlyEquivalent D E) : LinearlyEquivalent E D :=
    63	  (linearlyEquivalent_iff_divisorClass_eq E D).mpr
    64	    ((linearlyEquivalent_iff_divisorClass_eq D E).mp h).symm
    65	
    66	/-- Linear equivalence is transitive. -/
    67	theorem linearlyEquivalent_trans {D E F : CurveDivisor k X}
    68	    (hDE : LinearlyEquivalent D E) (hEF : LinearlyEquivalent E F) :
    69	    LinearlyEquivalent D F :=
    70	  (linearlyEquivalent_iff_divisorClass_eq D F).mpr
    71	    ((linearlyEquivalent_iff_divisorClass_eq D E).mp hDE |>.trans
    72	      ((linearlyEquivalent_iff_divisorClass_eq E F).mp hEF))
    73	
    74	/-- Linear equivalence bundled as a setoid on curve divisors. -/
    75	def linearEquivalenceSetoid : Setoid (CurveDivisor k X) where
    76	  r := LinearlyEquivalent
    77	  iseqv := ⟨linearlyEquivalent_refl, fun h => linearlyEquivalent_symm h,
    78	    fun hDE hEF => linearlyEquivalent_trans hDE hEF⟩
    79	
    80	/-- Source-style characterization of linear equivalence by one nonzero
    81	rational function. -/
    82	theorem linearlyEquivalent_iff_exists (D E : CurveDivisor k X) :
    83	    LinearlyEquivalent D E ↔
    84	      ∃ g : X.left.functionFieldˣ, D - E = principalDivisor g := by
    85	  rw [LinearlyEquivalent, mem_principalDivisors_iff]
    86	  constructor
    87	  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    88	    exact ⟨g, hg.symm⟩
    89	  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    90	    exact ⟨g, hg.symm⟩
    91	
    92	/-- Every principal divisor represents the zero divisor class. -/
    93	@[simp]
    94	theorem divisorClass_principalDivisor (g : X.left.functionFieldˣ) :
    95	    divisorClass (principalDivisor g) = 0 := by
    96	  apply (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff (principalDivisor g)).mpr
    97	  exact (mem_principalDivisors_iff (principalDivisor g)).mpr ⟨g, rfl⟩
    98	
    99	/-- Two divisors have the same class exactly when their difference is principal. -/
   100	theorem divisorClass_eq_iff_exists_principal (D E : CurveDivisor k X) :
   101	    divisorClass D = divisorClass E ↔
   102	      ∃ g : X.left.functionFieldˣ, D - E = principalDivisor g := by
   103	  rw [← linearlyEquivalent_iff_divisorClass_eq,
   104	    linearlyEquivalent_iff_exists]
   105	
   106	/-- A divisor represents the zero class exactly when it is principal. -/
   107	theorem divisorClass_eq_zero_iff_exists_principal (D : CurveDivisor k X) :
   108	    divisorClass D = 0 ↔
   109	      ∃ g : X.left.functionFieldˣ, D = principalDivisor g := by
   110	  rw [← divisorClass_principalDivisor (1 : X.left.functionFieldˣ)]
   111	  rw [← linearlyEquivalent_iff_divisorClass_eq,
   112	    linearlyEquivalent_iff_exists]
   113	  simp
   114	
   115	end Hartshorne

     9	/-!
    10	# Hartshorne II.6: degree on divisor classes
    11	
    12	The geometric assertion that a principal divisor on a complete nonsingular
    13	curve has degree zero is kept as an explicit input here.  Once that input is
    14	available, the already-defined divisor degree descends canonically to the
    15	divisor class group.
    16	-/
    17	
    18	set_option autoImplicit false
    19	
    20	universe u
    21	
    22	open CategoryTheory
    23	open AlgebraicGeometry
    24	
    25	namespace Hartshorne
    26	
    27	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    28	variable {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} [IsIntegral X.left]
    29	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] [IsProper X.hom]
    30	
    31	/-! The missing geometric input in the degree descent is isolated explicitly. -/
    32	
    33	/-- Every principal divisor has degree zero.
    34	
    35	This is the valuation-theoretic statement of Hartshorne II.6.10.  It is an
    36	explicit hypothesis so that the quotient construction below does not conceal
    37	an unproved geometric assertion.
    38	-/
    39	def PrincipalDivisorsHaveDegreeZero : Prop :=
    40	  ∀ g : X.left.functionFieldˣ, CurveDivisor.degree (principalDivisor g) = 0
    41	
    42	theorem principalDivisors_le_degreeHom_ker
    43	    (hzero : PrincipalDivisorsHaveDegreeZero (k := k) (X := X)) :
    44	    principalDivisors ≤ (CurveDivisor.degreeHom (k := k) (X := X)).ker := by
    45	  intro D hD
    46	  rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker]
    47	  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := (mem_principalDivisors_iff D).mp hD
    48	  rw [← hg]
    49	  rw [CurveDivisor.degreeHom_apply]
    50	  exact hzero g
    51	
    52	/-- The degree homomorphism induced on the divisor class group. -/
    53	noncomputable def degreeClass
    54	    (hzero : PrincipalDivisorsHaveDegreeZero (k := k) (X := X)) :
    55	    DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (X := X) →+ ℤ :=
    56	  QuotientAddGroup.lift principalDivisors
    57	    (CurveDivisor.degreeHom (k := k) (X := X))
    58	    (principalDivisors_le_degreeHom_ker hzero)
    59	
    60	@[simp]
    61	theorem degreeClass_divisorClass
    62	    (hzero : PrincipalDivisorsHaveDegreeZero (k := k) (X := X))
    63	    (D : CurveDivisor k X) :
    64	    degreeClass hzero (divisorClass D) = CurveDivisor.degree D := by
    65	  change (QuotientAddGroup.lift principalDivisors
    66	      (CurveDivisor.degreeHom (k := k) (X := X)) _) 
    67	      (D : CurveDivisor k X ⧸ principalDivisors) = _
    68	  rw [QuotientAddGroup.lift_mk']
    69	  exact CurveDivisor.degreeHom_apply D
    70	
    71	@[simp]
    72	theorem degreeClass_zero
    73	    (hzero : PrincipalDivisorsHaveDegreeZero (k := k) (X := X)) :
    74	    degreeClass hzero (0 : DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (X := X)) = 0 :=
    75	  map_zero (degreeClass hzero)
    76	
    77	/-! The quotient map sends every principal divisor to the zero class, so the
    78	degree descended above vanishes on principal classes as well. -/
    79	
    80	@[simp]
    81	theorem degreeClass_principalDivisor
    82	    (hzero : PrincipalDivisorsHaveDegreeZero (k := k) (X := X))
    83	    (g : X.left.functionFieldˣ) :
    84	    degreeClass hzero (divisorClass (principalDivisor g)) = 0 := by
    85	  rw [divisorClass_principalDivisor, degreeClass_zero]
    86	
    87	theorem degreeClass_add
    88	    (hzero : PrincipalDivisorsHaveDegreeZero (k := k) (X := X))
    89	    (a b : DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (X := X)) :
    90	    degreeClass hzero (a + b) = degreeClass hzero a + degreeClass hzero b :=
    91	  map_add (degreeClass hzero) a b
    92	
    93	/-! ## Degree-zero classes and the degree splitting attached to a point -/
    94	
    95	/-- The subgroup of divisor classes of degree zero. -/
    96	noncomputable def degreeZeroDivisorClasses
    97	    (hzero : PrincipalDivisorsHaveDegreeZero (k := k) (X := X)) :
    98	    AddSubgroup (DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (X := X)) :=
    99	  (degreeClass hzero).ker
   100	
   101	@[simp]
   102	theorem mem_degreeZeroDivisorClasses_iff
   103	    (hzero : PrincipalDivisorsHaveDegreeZero (k := k) (X := X))
   104	    (a : DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (X := X)) :
   105	    a ∈ degreeZeroDivisorClasses hzero ↔ degreeClass hzero a = 0 :=
   106	  AddMonoidHom.mem_ker
   107	
   108	@[simp]
   109	theorem divisorClass_mem_degreeZeroDivisorClasses_iff
   110	    (hzero : PrincipalDivisorsHaveDegreeZero (k := k) (X := X))
   111	    (D : CurveDivisor k X) :
   112	    divisorClass D ∈ degreeZeroDivisorClasses hzero ↔
   113	      CurveDivisor.degree D = 0 := by
   114	  rw [mem_degreeZeroDivisorClasses_iff, degreeClass_divisorClass]
   115	
   116	/-- Multiples of a non-generic point, viewed in the divisor class group. -/
   117	noncomputable def pointClassHom
   118	    (x : {x : X.left // x ≠ genericPoint X.left}) :
   119	    ℤ →+ DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (X := X) :=
   120	  divisorClass.comp (Finsupp.singleAddHom x)
   121	
   122	@[simp]
   123	theorem pointClassHom_apply
   124	    (x : {x : X.left // x ≠ genericPoint X.left}) (n : ℤ) :
   125	    pointClassHom (k := k) x n = divisorClass (Finsupp.single x n) :=
   126	  rfl
   127	
   128	@[simp]
   129	theorem degreeClass_pointClassHom
   130	    (hzero : PrincipalDivisorsHaveDegreeZero (k := k) (X := X))
   131	    (x : {x : X.left // x ≠ genericPoint X.left}) (n : ℤ) :
   132	    degreeClass hzero (pointClassHom (k := k) x n) = n := by
   133	  rw [pointClassHom_apply, degreeClass_divisorClass,
   134	    CurveDivisor.degree_single]
   135	
   136	/-- The class attached to `n` is the `n`-fold multiple of the point class. -/
   137	theorem pointClassHom_eq_zsmul
   138	    (x : {x : X.left // x ≠ genericPoint X.left}) (n : ℤ) :
   139	    pointClassHom (k := k) x n = n • pointClassHom (k := k) x 1 := by
   140	  simpa using (map_zsmul (pointClassHom (k := k) x) n (1 : ℤ))
   141	
   142	/-- A chosen non-generic point gives a section of the degree map. -/
   143	theorem degreeClass_comp_pointClassHom
   144	    (hzero : PrincipalDivisorsHaveDegreeZero (k := k) (X := X))
   145	    (x : {x : X.left // x ≠ genericPoint X.left}) :
   146	    (degreeClass hzero).comp (pointClassHom (k := k) x) =
   147	      AddMonoidHom.id ℤ := by
   148	  apply AddMonoidHom.ext
   149	  intro n
   150	  rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, degreeClass_pointClassHom]
   151	  rfl
   152	
   153	/-- If the curve has a non-generic point, every integer occurs as the degree of
   154	a divisor class. -/
   155	theorem degreeClass_surjective_of_point
   156	    (hzero : PrincipalDivisorsHaveDegreeZero (k := k) (X := X))
   157	    (x : {x : X.left // x ≠ genericPoint X.left}) :
   158	    Function.Surjective (degreeClass hzero) := by
   159	  intro n
   160	  exact ⟨pointClassHom (k := k) x n, degreeClass_pointClassHom hzero x n⟩
   161	
   162	/-- Relative to a chosen non-generic point, every divisor class is the sum of
   163	a degree-zero class and a canonical point class of the same degree. -/
   164	theorem exists_degreeZero_add_pointClass
   165	    (hzero : PrincipalDivisorsHaveDegreeZero (k := k) (X := X))
   166	    (x : {x : X.left // x ≠ genericPoint X.left})
   167	    (a : DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (X := X)) :
   168	    ∃ a₀ : DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (X := X),
   169	      a₀ ∈ degreeZeroDivisorClasses hzero ∧
   170	        a = a₀ + pointClassHom (k := k) x (degreeClass hzero a) := by
   171	  let px := pointClassHom (k := k) x (degreeClass hzero a)
   172	  refine ⟨a - px, ?_, ?_⟩
   173	  · have hpx : degreeClass hzero px = degreeClass hzero a := by

   175	        (pointClassHom (k := k) x (degreeClass hzero a)) = _
   176	      exact degreeClass_pointClassHom hzero x (degreeClass hzero a)

   178	  · dsimp [px]
   179	    abel
   180	
   181	/-- Degree is invariant under linear equivalence once principal divisors have
   182	degree zero. -/
   183	theorem degree_eq_of_linearlyEquivalent
   184	    (hzero : PrincipalDivisorsHaveDegreeZero (k := k) (X := X))
   185	    {D E : CurveDivisor k X} (h : LinearlyEquivalent D E) :
   186	    CurveDivisor.degree D = CurveDivisor.degree E := by

    14	an integer-valued order on nonzero rational functions. On a quasi-compact
    15	finite-type curve, only finitely many of these orders are nonzero. This file
    16	constructs the resulting principal divisor and records that principal
    17	divisors form an additive subgroup of the divisor group.
    18	
    19	The sign is the classical one: a uniformizer has order `+1`. Mathlib's adic
    20	valuation has additive value `-1` on a uniformizer, so `orderZAt` inverts its
    21	value after extracting the integer-valued unit.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	
    26	universe u
    27	
    28	open CategoryTheory Limits
    29	open AlgebraicGeometry

    33	/-!
    34	## Orders at non-generic points
    35	-/
    36	
    37	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    38	
    39	/-- The height-one prime of a DVR stalk, represented by its maximal ideal. -/
    40	noncomputable def stalkHeightOne (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X] (x : X)
    41	    [IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)] :
    42	    IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (X.presheaf.stalk x) where
    43	  asIdeal := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)
    44	  isPrime := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal (X.presheaf.stalk x)).isPrime
    45	  ne_bot := IsDiscreteValuationRing.not_a_field (X.presheaf.stalk x)
    46	
    47	/-- The adic valuation of the function field at a non-generic point of an
    48	integral smooth curve. -/
    49	noncomputable def orderAt (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    50	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 f] [IsIntegral X] {x : X}
    51	    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) :
    52	    Valuation X.functionField (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := by
    53	  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing f hx
    54	  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDedekindDomain f hx
    55	  exact (stalkHeightOne X x).valuation X.functionField
    56	
    57	/-- The classical integer-valued order on units of the function field. -/
    58	noncomputable def orderZAt (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    59	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 f] [IsIntegral X] {x : X}
    60	    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) : X.functionFieldˣ →* Multiplicative ℤ :=
    61	  invMonoidHom.comp
    62	    (WithZero.unitsWithZeroEquiv.toMonoidHom.comp
    63	      (Units.map (orderAt f hx).toMonoidWithZeroHom.toMonoidHom))
    64	
    65	/-- `orderAt` is the adic valuation of the maximal ideal of the stalk. -/
    66	theorem orderAt_eq_valuation (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    67	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 f] [IsIntegral X] {x : X}
    68	    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) :
    69	    letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing f hx
    70	    orderAt f hx = (stalkHeightOne X x).valuation X.functionField :=
    71	  rfl
    72	
    73	/-- A rational function represented by a section has trivial order wherever
    74	that section is a unit. -/
    75	theorem orderAt_eq_one_of_mem_basicOpen (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    76	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 f] [IsIntegral X] {x : X}
    77	    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) {U : X.Opens} (s : Γ(X, U))
    78	    (heta : genericPoint X ∈ U) (hx_mem : x ∈ X.basicOpen s) :
    79	    orderAt f hx ((X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) heta).hom s) = 1 := by
    80	  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing f hx
    81	  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDedekindDomain f hx
    82	  have hxU : x ∈ U := X.basicOpen_le s hx_mem
    83	  have hunit : IsUnit ((X.presheaf.germ U x hxU).hom s) :=
    84	    (X.mem_basicOpen s x hxU).mp hx_mem
    85	  have hord : orderAt f hx = (stalkHeightOne X x).valuation X.functionField := rfl
    86	  have hgs : (X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) heta).hom s =
    87	      algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
    88	        ((X.presheaf.germ U x hxU).hom s) := by
    89	    rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
    90	    exact (X.presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes_apply
    91	      hxU ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial) s).symm
    92	  rw [hgs, hord, IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_eq_one_iff_notMem]
    93	  exact IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mpr hunit
    94	
    95	/-- The classical order is zero exactly when the underlying valuation is
    96	trivial. Multiplicative `1` represents additive order zero. -/
    97	theorem orderZAt_eq_one_iff (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    98	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 f] [IsIntegral X] {x : X}
    99	    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) (g : X.functionFieldˣ) :
   100	    orderZAt f hx g = 1 ↔ orderAt f hx (g : X.functionField) = 1 := by
   101	  rw [orderZAt]
   102	  simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, invMonoidHom_apply, inv_eq_one,
   103	    MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom, EmbeddingLike.map_eq_one_iff, Units.ext_iff, Units.coe_map,
   104	    Units.val_one]
   105	  rfl
   106	
   107	/-- A nonzero rational function has nonzero order at only finitely many
   108	points of a quasi-compact finite-type smooth curve. -/
   109	theorem orderZAt_support_finite (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
   110	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 f] [IsIntegral X] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
   111	    [QuasiCompact f] (g : X.functionFieldˣ) :
   112	    {p : {x : X // x ≠ genericPoint X} | orderZAt f p.2 g ≠ 1}.Finite := by
   113	  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian f
   114	  haveI : CompactSpace X := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f
   115	  haveI : IsNoetherian X := ⟨⟩
   116	  obtain ⟨U, hetaU, s, hs⟩ := X.presheaf.exists_germ_eq (g : X.functionField)
   117	  have heta_basic : genericPoint X ∈ X.basicOpen s := by
   118	    rw [X.mem_basicOpen s (genericPoint X) hetaU, hs]
   119	    exact g.isUnit
   120	  have hZ : ((X.basicOpen s : Set X)ᶜ).Finite := by
   121	    refine finite_closed_of_avoids_genericPoint
   122	      (fun _ _ h => smoothCurve_specializes_eq_genericPoint_or_eq f h)
   123	      (X.basicOpen s).isOpen.isClosed_compl ?_
   124	    simpa using heta_basic
   125	  refine (hZ.preimage (Subtype.val_injective.injOn)).subset ?_
   126	  intro p hp
   127	  rw [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_compl_iff]
   128	  intro hmem
   129	  apply hp
   130	  rw [orderZAt_eq_one_iff, ← hs]
   131	  exact orderAt_eq_one_of_mem_basicOpen f p.2 s hetaU hmem

   133	/-!
   134	## Principal divisors on complete smooth curves
   135	-/
   136	
   137	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
   138	variable {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} [IsIntegral X.left]
   139	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] [IsProper X.hom]
   140	
   141	/-- The principal divisor of a nonzero rational function. -/
   142	noncomputable def principalDivisor
   143	    (g : X.left.functionFieldˣ) : CurveDivisor k X :=
   144	  Finsupp.onFinset (orderZAt_support_finite X.hom g).toFinset
   145	    (fun p => Multiplicative.toAdd (orderZAt X.hom p.2 g))
   146	    (fun p hp => by
   147	      rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
   148	      exact fun he => hp (by rw [he, toAdd_one]))
   149	
   150	/-- The coefficient of a principal divisor is the corresponding order. -/
   151	@[simp]
   152	theorem coeffAt_principalDivisor (g : X.left.functionFieldˣ)
   153	    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) :
   154	    CurveDivisor.coeffAt hx (principalDivisor g) =
   155	      Multiplicative.toAdd (orderZAt X.hom hx g) :=
   156	  rfl
   157	
   158	/-- Principal divisors turn multiplication of rational functions into
   159	addition of divisors. -/
   160	theorem principalDivisor_mul (g h : X.left.functionFieldˣ) :
   161	    principalDivisor (g * h) = principalDivisor g + principalDivisor h := by
   162	  apply CurveDivisor.ext_coeffAt
   163	  intro x hx
   164	  simp only [coeffAt_principalDivisor, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add]
   165	  rw [map_mul, toAdd_mul]
   166	
   167	/-- The principal divisor of the constant function one is zero. -/
   168	@[simp]
   169	theorem principalDivisor_one :
   170	    principalDivisor (1 : X.left.functionFieldˣ) = 0 := by
   171	  apply CurveDivisor.ext_coeffAt
   172	  intro x hx
   173	  simp only [coeffAt_principalDivisor, map_one, toAdd_one,
   174	    CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero]
   175	
   176	/-- Inverting a rational function negates its principal divisor. -/
   177	@[simp]
   178	theorem principalDivisor_inv (g : X.left.functionFieldˣ) :
   179	    principalDivisor g⁻¹ = -principalDivisor g := by
   180	  apply CurveDivisor.ext_coeffAt
   181	  intro x hx
   182	  simp only [coeffAt_principalDivisor, map_inv, toAdd_inv,
   183	    CurveDivisor.coeffAt_neg]
   184	
   185	/-- Dividing rational functions subtracts their principal divisors. -/
   186	theorem principalDivisor_div (g h : X.left.functionFieldˣ) :
   187	    principalDivisor (g / h) = principalDivisor g - principalDivisor h := by
   188	  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, principalDivisor_mul, principalDivisor_inv]
   189	  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
   190	
   191	/-- Principal divisors as an additive homomorphism from the multiplicative
   192	group of rational functions, viewed additively. -/
   193	noncomputable def principalDivisorAddHom :
   194	    Additive (X.left.functionFieldˣ) →+ CurveDivisor k X where
   195	  toFun g := principalDivisor (Additive.toMul g)
   196	  map_zero' := principalDivisor_one
   197	  map_add' g h := principalDivisor_mul (Additive.toMul g) (Additive.toMul h)
   198	
   199	@[simp]
   200	theorem principalDivisorAddHom_apply (g : Additive (X.left.functionFieldˣ)) :
   201	    principalDivisorAddHom g = principalDivisor (Additive.toMul g) :=
   202	  rfl
   203	
   204	/-- The additive subgroup of principal divisors. -/
   205	noncomputable def principalDivisors : AddSubgroup (CurveDivisor k X) :=
   206	  principalDivisorAddHom.range
   207	
   208	/-- Membership in the subgroup of principal divisors is witnessed by a
   209	nonzero rational function. -/
   210	theorem mem_principalDivisors_iff (D : CurveDivisor k X) :
   211	    D ∈ principalDivisors ↔ ∃ g : X.left.functionFieldˣ, principalDivisor g = D := by
   212	  constructor
   213	  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
   214	    exact ⟨Additive.toMul g, hg⟩
   215	  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
   216	    exact ⟨Additive.ofMul g, hg⟩
   217	
   218	end Hartshorne
